events.title: Claw Machine
events.text: A claw machine full of tiny charms blinks at you. One try costs 25 coins.

events.title: Lost & Found
events.text: A box behind the counter is labelled "LOST & FOUND". Something shiny is inside, but the box crackles with static.

options.label: Take the shiny thing
options.note: Gain a charm. Add a Static curse.

events.title: Vending Machine
events.text: A vending machine hums in the corner. The coin slot is taped over, but the snacks look great.

options.label: Buy a snack (20 coins)
options.note: Gain a random snack. Needs an empty snack slot.

options.label: Give it a kick
options.note: Take 5 damage. Maybe coins fall out.

events.title: Photo Booth
events.text: A sticker photo booth. Strike a pose and change something about yourself.

events.title: Gacha Capsule
events.text: A capsule toy machine with card capsules inside. 20 coins per spin.

events.title: Forum Thread
events.text: Someone left a forum open on a PC. The thread title: "best combo builds??"

events.title: Comfy Booth
events.text: An empty booth with a blanket and a reclining chair.

events.title: Mysterious Gamer
events.text: "Wanna trade?" A gamer in a mask offers to swap one of your cards for something rare.

options.label: Trade
options.note: Remove a card, gain a random rare card.

events.title: Karaoke Room
events.text: Room 4 has a free mic and a song list as thick as a phone book. Someone left the volume on max.

options.label: Belt out a ballad
options.note: Lose 6 HP. Gain Power Ballad (event card).

options.label: Pocket the golden mic
options.note: Gain Golden Mic (event charm). Add a Static curse.

events.title: Broken Photocopier
events.text: The photocopier is blinking "PAPER JAM", but it still prints if you hold the lid down.

options.label: Copy a card
options.note: Copy a card in your deck. Add a Static curse.

events.title: Cup Ramen Station
events.text: A hot water tap and a shelf of cup ramen. One says "EXTREME FIRE NOODLE" in big red letters.

options.label: Extreme Fire Noodle
options.note: Lose 5 HP. +2 Fighting Spirit in your next fight.

events.title: Lost Kitten
events.text: A tiny kitten is hiding under a desk, meowing at everyone who walks by.

options.label: Follow it
options.note: Lose 4 HP. Gain Kitten Bell (event charm).

events.title: Free Wi-Fi?
events.text: A network called "FREE_WIFI_NOT_A_SCAM" pops up. The signal is very strong.

options.label: Connect
options.note: Gain 45 coins. Add a Spam card to your deck.

events.title: Free Samples
events.text: A worker with a tray of tiny cups calls out: "Free samples! Try one, try two, nobody is counting!"

options.label: Stuff your cheeks
options.note: Lose 5 HP. Gain Hamster Cheeks (event charm): +1 snack slot.

events.title: Snack Swap
events.text: A kid at the counter has a binder full of rare cards and very empty pockets. "I'll trade you. Snacks only."
events.requires: a snack in your snack bar

options.label: Trade a snack for a card
options.note: Give a snack. Gain a random uncommon card.

options.label: Trade 2 snacks for a charm
options.note: Give 2 snacks. Gain a random charm.

events.title: Midnight Konbini Run
events.text: The konbini downstairs is open all night. The fridges hum, and the onigiri are half price.

options.label: Stock up (35 coins)
options.note: Fill all your empty snack slots.

options.label: Buy a pocket fridge (60 coins)
options.note: Gain Pocket Fridge (event charm): fill empty snack slots on each new floor.

events.title: The Cotton Candy Lady
events.text: A lady with a squeaky cart spins sugar into fluffy clouds. "Pink or rainbow, sweetie?"

events.title: Sweet Potato Cart
events.text: A grandpa roasts sweet potatoes in an old drum by the door. The whole floor smells amazing.

events.title: Dalgona Challenge
events.text: A booth with a sign: "Carve out the shape without breaking it and win a prize!" A needle and a honeycomb candy wait on the table.

options.label: Try the star (easy)
options.note: 70%: gain Dalgona Candy (event snack). Fail: lose 3 HP.

options.label: Try the heart (hard)
options.note: 35%: gain Dalgona Candy and 60 coins. Fail: lose 6 HP.

events.title: Dreamworld
events.text: You nod off at a PC and wake up somewhere soft and purple. Sheep float past. A sign says "Stay as long as you like."

options.label: Drift deeper
options.note: Gain Lucid Dream: the first Dreamy card you match each turn applies 1 more Sleepy.

events.title: Grandma's Kitchen
events.text: Behind a noren curtain there is a tiny kitchen. A grandma waves you in: "You look hungry. Sit, sit!"

options.label: Eat the soup
options.note: Gain Grandma's Soup: all your healing is Cozy.

events.title: The Back Room
events.text: A locked server closet, but the admin password is on a sticky note on the door. The screen inside glows green.

options.label: Log in as admin
options.note: Gain Root Access: your Glitch cards apply 2 more Glitch.

events.title: Bouncer Lessons
events.text: The café bouncer is on break. "You block like a pro. Want to learn the real stance?"

options.label: Learn the stance
options.note: Gain Bouncer's Stance: your Guard cards give 2 more Block.

events.title: Memory Palace
events.text: A door you have never noticed opens into a hall of photos: every card you have ever matched, hung in neat rows.

options.label: Take the key
options.note: Gain Palace Key: the first Memory card you match each turn reveals 1 more card.

events.title: Rhythm Tournament
events.text: The rhythm game corner is hosting a tournament, and your combos have the crowd chanting your name.

options.label: Play the final
options.note: Gain Encore: the first Combo card you match each turn adds 1 more combo.

events.title: Viral Thread
events.text: Your call-outs went viral. Everyone in the café is reading the thread, and they all want the next post.

options.label: Post the sequel
options.note: Gain Trending: Exposed enemies take 75% more damage instead of 50%.

events.title: Crossover Episode
events.text: Two anime are playing on the big screen at once, and somehow the characters are fighting side by side.

options.label: Watch the whole thing
options.note: Gain Crossover: the first hybrid card you match in each fight gives +2 energy.

statuses.name: Sleepy
statuses.help: deals 25% less damage. An enemy with 3 Sleepy falls Asleep (each time it wakes up, it takes 3 more).

statuses.name: Asleep
statuses.help: skips its turns until it wakes up. Can't get more Sleepy while asleep. Glitch still ticks.

statuses.name: Glitch
statuses.help: loses that much HP each turn, then Glitch goes down by 1.

statuses.name: Cozy
statuses.help: Card keyword. Healing past your max HP hits the enemy for the extra amount.

styles.name: Glitch

styles.name: Guard

styles.name: Combo

styles.name: Dreamy
